verdict.rationale: Fathom documents a few fixed background automations that run after meetings without user action: CRM field sync that updates records automatically, automatic topic monitoring and keyword alerts, and webhooks that push new meeting content to a URL of the user's choice. These are narrow, predefined behaviours, not user-configurable autonomous automations or agents. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder, user-defined autonomous or agentic tasks, recurring scheduled automations, depth documentation on configuring the CRM sync and alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically
Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
